rationale: FWONK gapped up ~6.9% on no news catalyst, opened at $105.75, spiked to $108.35, and has since pulled back to $105.44 — sitting at only 13% of today's range, just 0.42% above the session low, with price below both VWAP ($106.32) and the 9-EMA ($106.03). The broad market is under significant pressure (SPY -1.83%, VIXY +11.61%), which creates headwinds for a long, yet the gap-up origin and proximity to the session low make a short risky if support holds. With no news to explain the move and price compressed near the low in a deteriorating tape, the risk/reward is unclear in both directions.
